items.raw_excerpt: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) to stop awarding firearms as prizes to village and subdistrict chiefs.
items.summary_en: Thailand's prime minister told officials to stop giving guns as prizes to village and subdistrict chiefs. The leaders used to get a firearm as a reward for their work. The practice will now end.
items.summary_ko: 태국 총리가 마을 대표와 지구장에게 총을 상품으로 주던 관행을 중단하라고 지시했다. 이들은 그동안 업무 성과에 대한 상으로 총을 받아 왔다. 앞으로 이 관행은 사라질 예정이다.
items.title_en: Thailand stops gun prizes for village leaders
items.title_ko: 태국, 마을 대표 상품으로 총 주던 관행 중단
items.title_original: Gun prizes for village leaders axed

items.raw_excerpt: More than 500 endangered blue-tailed skinks are released on Horsburgh Island in the Cocos (Keeling) Islands in a bid to save the species after it was almost wiped out by predatory snakes.
items.summary_en: More than 500 endangered blue-tailed skinks were released on Horsburgh Island in the Cocos (Keeling) Islands. The move aims to save the species, which was nearly wiped out by predatory snakes.
items.summary_ko: 멸종 위기에 처한 파란꼬리도마뱀 500여 마리가 코코스 제도 호스버그 섬에 풀려났습니다. 포식성 뱀에 거의 전멸했던 이 종을 살리기 위한 조치입니다.
items.title_en: Endangered skinks find new hope on remote island
items.title_ko: 멸종 위기 도마뱀, 뱀 없는 섬에서 새 희망 찾아
items.title_original: Skinks facing extinction find new hope away from predatory snakes

items.raw_excerpt: Summer is in full swing, and that means it's time to visit some of Ontario's charming beach towns. From cozy coastal gems to vibrant waterfront communities, the province has no shortage of lakeside villages to explore.
items.summary_en: Ontario has many lovely beach towns to visit this summer. From cozy small lakeside villages to lively waterfront communities, there is no shortage of places to explore. A true Ontarian should visit at least five of these ten towns.
items.summary_ko: 올여름 온타리오에는 가볼 만한 정겨운 해변 마을이 많습니다. 아늑한 호숫가 작은 마을부터 활기찬 물가 공동체까지 볼거리가 부족하지 않습니다. 진짜 온타리오 사람이라면 이 열 곳 중 다섯 곳은 꼭 가봐야 합니다.
items.title_en: 10 Charming Beach Towns in Ontario to Visit This Summer
items.title_ko: 온타리오에서 올여름 가볼 만한 정겨운 해변 마을 10곳
items.title_original: You're not a true Ontarian unless you've been to at least 5 of these 10 charming beach towns - Narcity
